summary: recallRecord must keep a CodeInfo field tagged json:"code_info", and printRecallRecord must render it as the Lots/Expiry line. A regeneration must not drop the field or its tag: the generated struct originally omitted it, so lot numbers and expiry dates never reached the output.
reason: The field was added in #1942 without a record, and every other recall test builds a recallRecord by hand, so a lost field or tag would leave the whole suite green. A hand-authored test in its own file decodes a raw payload and is the only guard on that path.
validated_outcome: TestRecallRecordCodeInfoRoundTrip fails on four mutations of recalls.go (wrong struct tag, field not passed to the renderer, value clipped to 40 runes, continuation indent removed), and all six pre-existing tests pass on each of them. With the wrong tag, the suite before this change passed in full.
